verdict.rationale: Kick auto-categorizes transactions with AI (97% first-pass), surfaces AI actions in an audit trail, and lets users query data, generate reports, and get suggestions via MCP/CLI and via AI assistants (Gemini/Claude/ChatGPT) reasoning over live Kick report data in Sheets. This covers in-product AI insights/suggestions directly on user financial data with approval workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and no native in-app chat/insights UI beyond categorization and external AI integrations.
